visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a shimmering grey turtleneck, stands before the 'PLAZA' store entrance. She points excitedly to the sign above her while smiling at the camera. The lighting is bright and even. (2) A fast-paced montage shows store shelves filled with colorful makeup products from brands like Laka and fwee, and skincare items like Anua bottles neatly arranged in a retail environment. (3) The scene shifts to character-themed merchandise including pouches, mugs, and a yellow 'Brunch Brother' thermos displayed on a white shelf. (4) The woman holds a white Snoopy-shaped soap/sanitizer dispenser in a close-up, showcasing its features. (5) She is seen in a snack aisle with warm lighting, picking a blue package from a shelf full of various packaged treats. (6) Close-up focus on the 'Body Care' section, specifically 'OHANA MAHAALO' fragrance testers and perfume bottles with pink floral labels. (7) She applies perfume to her wrist and smells it with a pleased expression, standing in the middle of a store aisle. (8) Product display of OHANA MAHAALO UV gel and stick against a clean, soft-lit background. (9) She demonstrates applying the pink and white sunscreen stick to her arm and then her cheek. (10) She pumps white UV gel from a large bottle onto her palm. (11) A man applies the same gel to his arm in a well-lit indoor room with a bedside lamp, giving a thumbs up to the camera. (12) An extreme close-up shows the white gel texture spreading easily on skin, highlighting its consistency. (13) The woman and a toddler boy are at an outdoor playground near a yellow climbing structure with 'X' and 'O' patterns. (14) The 'SUNBATH' sunscreen series is presented on a white surface: lotion, pump, stick, and spray. (15) She applies sunscreen to the boy's face and arms in a sunny park; the boy wears a white polo shirt and looks happy. (16) She rubs the SUNBATH stick on her own forearm. (17) In a quick cut, she pulls the sunscreen stick out of a brown leather handbag outdoors. (18) She sprays the SUNBATH sunscreen over her hair and neck while standing in the park. (19) She sprays the sunscreen on her leg while sitting on brick steps. (20) A final collage of all the featured OHANA MAHAALO and SUNBATH products is shown. (21) The woman holds a sunscreen tube in the park, smiling. (22) Closing shot of the woman holding the boy in a carrier, with a white heart graphic overlay.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with short brown hair, wearing a grey glittery turtleneck and later a white floral blouse. A toddler boy wearing a white polo shirt and beige shorts.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Brightly lit retail store shelves with cosmetics and character goods; a neutral indoor room with a bed and lamp; a green public park with trees, a playground, and city buildings in the distance.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Bright, upbeat acoustic pop music featuring a clear piano melody and rhythmic percussion starts immediately. A female voice with a friendly, high-arousal tone and excellent articulation begins narrating a shopping guide for Japan. (2) The narration remains fast-paced as she describes various cosmetics and snacks found in the PLAZA store. The music provides a consistent, happy atmosphere throughout the exploration. A soft 'pop' sound effect emphasizes some of the visual transitions between store aisles. (3) The speaker's tone becomes more descriptive and warm when talking about the OHANA MAHAALO perfumes. The background music maintains its steady tempo (around 115 BPM) with acoustic guitar strums becoming slightly more audible in the mix. (4) Transitioning to sunscreen details, the voice stays energetic and professional, explaining technical benefits like moisturizing ingredients and SPF ratings. The music stays consistent without any structural pauses or shifts in mode, remaining in a bright major key. (5) When discussing family use and outdoor applications, the voice feels relatable and warm. Subtle digital 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects are used for emphasis, integrated into the post-production design. (6) The video concludes with the narrator providing local availability info in Taiwan and a final call to action. The music and voice overlap until the last second of the video, followed by a quick master fade out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Store Exploration -> Product Introduction -> Application Demo -> Availability Info -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a lifestyle recommendation and promotion for Japanese cosmetics and sunscreen brands (OHANA MAHAALO and SUNBATH) available at PLAZA stores. It highlights product variety, specific skin benefits for summer and family use, and informs the audience that these items are also accessible at department store counters in Taiwan.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video provides detailed product demonstrations, mentions specific brand names multiple times, lists store counts, and explicitly mentions availability for purchase in Taiwan.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly polished social-media vlog using fast-paced editing and bright visuals to showcase lifestyle products. The transition from shopping to real-world usage scenarios (home and park) effectively bridges product discovery with practical application.
